messages:
alex: I'm blocked trying to create a new GPU node pool in GCP (project redwood-prod-us). Node pool create fails with QUOTA_EXCEEDED for 'IN_USE_ADDRESSES' and regional GPU quota. P2 — customer rollout tomorrow, need help ASAP.

marta: Which quotas exactly are failing? For GKE/GPU clusters we usually need increases to: regional GPU quota (A100/A2 families), 'In-use IP addresses' (alias IPs / secondary ranges), and sometimes external IP or regional CPU quota. Also check pod-density limits from the CNI.

alex: Error shows both 'In-use IP addresses' and 'NVIDIA_A100_80GB_GPUS' exceeded in us-west1. Target setup: 6 nodes x 4 A100 (24 GPUs total). Expected ~2,400 pods cluster-wide (mix of inference and sidecars). Current alias IP quota is ~1,000, so we'll hit that if we scale. Project id: redwood-prod-us.

samir: Heads up on cost — 24 A100s is non-trivial. Ballpark monthly cost depending on sustained usage and committed discounts could be $20k–$60k. Consider denser packing or spot/preemptible for non-prod.

marta: I'll open the GCP support case. Suggested text to paste into the quota request form: 
```
Please increase the following quotas for project 'redwood-prod-us' in region 'us-west1':
- NVIDIA_A100_80GB_GPUS: from 8 to 48 (regional)
- In-use IP addresses (alias ranges): from 1000 to 5000 (project-wide / region-level as applicable)
- Static external IPs: from 50 to 200 (optional)
Reason: Production rollout requires 24 GPUs across 6 nodes and up to ~2,400 pods. GKE VPC-native requires sufficient alias IP capacity.
Priority: P2.
Contacts: marta@redwood.com, alex@redwood.com
```

marta: Operational notes:
- For pod density, GKE VPC-native default maxPods is 110 per node. If you require >110 pods/node we need to allocate larger secondary ranges per node or switch CNI IPAM (non-trivial).
- Make sure to request the exact accelerator SKU name from the console (e.g., 'a2-megagpu-16g' vs generic 'A100') or support might ask for clarification.

alex: Helpful. infra-bot: created case GCP-7654321 and added billing alert. Link: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/7654321 :eyes: 

samir: Temporary workaround: spin up node pool in us-central1 (where we still have quota) and label it `region=warm-spot`, use affinity/topologySpreadConstraints to route traffic. Not ideal for latency but unblocks rollout.

lina: Also add VM family quota checks (CPUs and GPUs in the same family). If we request GPUs without enough regional CPU quota or GPUs-per-project limits, support will reject. Include desired machine type and preemptible vs on-demand in the request.

alex: I'll update the request with exact accelerator SKUs, machine types, and the billing account. Thanks everyone — will post updates when GCP responds. :thumbsup:
